description_en: Batch retrieve driver configurations of edge instances
description_zh: 批量获取边缘实例驱动配置
kebab_example: aliyun iot batch-get-edge-instance-driver-configs --iot-instance-id iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000 --instance-id F3APY0tPLhmgGtx00000 --driver-ids example-string --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: BatchGetEdgeInstanceDriverConfigs

parameters.description_en: The ID of the Internet of Things (IoT) service instance. This parameter is not required for the public instance but required for Enterprise Edition instances.
parameters.description_zh: 实例ID。公共实例不传此参数，企业版实例需传入。
parameters.help_en: The ID of the Internet of Things (IoT) service instance. This parameter is not required for the public instance but required for Enterprise Edition instances
parameters.help_zh: 实例ID。公共实例不传此参数，企业版实例需传入
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.description_en:
The ID of the edge instance. To obtain the instance ID, perform the following steps: Log on to the [Link IoT Edge console](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list). On the **Edge Instances** page, move the pointer over the name of the edge instance that uses the drivers and obtain the instance ID.

You can also call the [QueryEdgeInstance](~~135214~~) operation to query the instance ID.
parameters.description_zh:
边缘实例ID。在[边缘计算控制台](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list)的**边缘实例**页面中，鼠标悬浮在目标边缘实例名称上获取ID。

您也可以调用[QueryEdgeInstance](~~135214~~)接口获取。

parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.description_en:
The list of driver IDs to query. You can obtain the ID by hovering your mouse over the target driver name on the **Driver Management** page in the [edge computing console](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list).  

You can also call the [QueryEdgeDriver](~~155776~~) API to obtain the driver IDs.  

> You can specify up to 20 driver IDs, which means you can retrieve configurations for up to 20 drivers in a single batch request.
parameters.description_zh:
要查询的驱动ID列表。在[边缘计算控制台](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list)的**驱动管理**页面中，鼠标悬浮在目标驱动名称上获取ID。

您也可以调用[QueryEdgeDriver](~~155776~~)接口获取。

> 最多可传入20个驱动ID，即最多可批量获取20个驱动的配置。
